name: Astera Labs
thesis: Nov 4 about 1:40pm ET (intraday, not final): $219.29 (-6.1%) despite a strong Q3 on Nov 3. Revenue $584.9M (+154% y/y, +49% q/q) vs a $540-560M guide; non-GAAP EPS $1.32 vs $1.16-1.21 guide; gross margin 72.4%. Q4 guide $730-750M revenue, non-GAAP EPS $1.62-1.66. Scorpio fabric switches are now the largest product line. Stock is about 43% below the Oct 7 close of $382.25.
risks: Beta near 3.8: falling on a beat-and-raise shows sentiment, not numbers, is driving it. AI-infra names sold off Nov 4 on data-centre policy fears after Democrats won Congress and Texas.
catalyst: Aries 7 (PCIe 7) sampling in Q4; Orion rack reference design via OEMs in Q1 2027; NVDA results Nov 17.

name: Advanced Micro Devices
thesis: Added. Nov 4 about 1:40pm ET (intraday, not final): $483.42 (-0.1%), after +3.7% Nov 3 and an after-hours jump that faded. Q3 revenue a record $13.4B; data centre $8.5B (+97%), 64% of revenue; non-GAAP EPS $2.09 vs $1.95 expected. Q4 guide about $17B (+/-3%, about +66% y/y) and 55% gross margin. Meta, Microsoft, OpenAI, Oracle and Anthropic are running on Helios.
risks: Fell about 24% in the month before results on AI-spend worries; MI450/Helios ramp is early; Client and Gaming -8% y/y.
catalyst: Helios and Venice production ramp in Q4; NVDA results Nov 17 as read-across.

name: Broadcom
thesis: Nov 4 about 1:40pm ET (intraday, not final): $327.51 (-1.4%) after +3.1% Nov 3. Held up better than AI-infra peers. Custom accelerators for Google, Meta, OpenAI and Anthropic plus Ethernet networking; the $63B Anthropic leasing vehicle (Oct 26) delivers from 2027. AMD's Q4 guide of about $17B (Nov 3) says AI-chip demand is still rising.
risks: Residual-value support on the Anthropic lease vehicle; a Democratic Congress and state-level data-centre limits could slow 2027-28 site build-outs that custom silicon depends on.
catalyst: Q4 FY26 results around Dec 10 (not yet confirmed); NVDA Nov 17 as sector read.

name: Celestica
thesis: Nov 4 about 1:40pm ET (intraday, not final): $234.17 (-9.9%) after +4.3% Nov 3; about 22% below the Oct 28 close of $299.80. No company news; fell with data-centre hardware on the election result. Q3 revenue $5.83B (+83%); 2027 outlook $40B revenue and $21.50 EPS, so the stock is now about 11x the 2027 EPS guide.
risks: Most revenue from a few hyperscalers; Texas holds roughly 25-30% of planned US data-centre GW (Wells Fargo, Ives) and the incoming governor wants a moratorium. 2026 FCF cut to $460M.
catalyst: New buyback (up to 2.5% of float) to be filed in Q4; Q4 results late January.

name: SK hynix
thesis: Nov 4 about 1:40pm ET (intraday, not final): $143.94 (-4.5%) after +2.1% Nov 3. Q3 operating profit about KRW 83.3T on revenue over KRW 100T; HBM4 in mass production and expected to pass HBM3E in Q4. TrendForce DRAM spot softened Nov 4 (DDR4 16Gb -0.96%, DDR5 16Gb -0.27%).
risks: Memory cycle near a peak and the stock is crowded; spot DRAM has stopped rising; Kioxia's weak guide shows not all memory names are winning.
catalyst: Q4 HBM4 mix shift; TrendForce October contract prices; NVDA Nov 17.

name: Bloom Energy
thesis: Nov 4 about 1:40pm ET (intraday, not final): $196.60 (-8.1%), giving back the Nov 3 gain (+9.1%) on Barclays' upgrade and the 1 GW California Resources MOU. Q3 revenue $1.236B (+138%); 2026 guide $4.4-4.6B. Onsite fuel cells are one answer to grid delays, but Nov 4 traded as an AI-power basket.
risks: Behind-the-meter gas power for data centres is the kind of build Texas and state-level Democrats are targeting; capex turned Q3 cash flow negative; Oracle and Brookfield site timing.
catalyst: Oracle Jupiter permit Nov 23; 2027 guidance with Q4 results (February).

name: GE Vernova
thesis: Nov 4 about 1:40pm ET (intraday, not final): $823.99 (-10.3%) after +6.5% Nov 3. Argus cut its target to $1,100 from $1,300 (Buy kept); the stock fell with Vertiv and Eaton on the Democratic sweep. Analysts note only about 20% of contracted gas-turbine capacity serves data centres. Q3 orders +96%, backlog about $197-200B, buyback lifted to $20B.
risks: Policy risk on data-centre power (Bernstein: about 244 GW, 56% of the US pipeline, is politically exposed, though it calls this overstated); Trench (~$9B) integration.
catalyst: Trench deal close; Q4 orders and gas slot conversion.

name: Vertiv
thesis: Nov 4 about 1:40pm ET (intraday, not final): $203.91 (-13.6%), the worst on the list, after +5.2% Nov 3; now about 17% below the Oct 29 close. Fell on fears a Democratic Congress and a Texas moratorium slow data-centre builds. Q3 revenue +61% to $4.31B; backlog orders are not affected by Congress.
risks: Stock trades on the 2027 build-out debate; Texas is roughly a quarter of planned US data-centre GW; UtilityInnovation earnout up to $1.15B.
catalyst: First 2027 guidance with Q4 results in February; any Texas legislative move on a moratorium.

name: Robinhood Markets
thesis: Nov 4 about 1:40pm ET (intraday, not final): $88.07 (+2.8%), up for a second day and one of the few names rising with the broad rally (Dow about +2.9%). Q3 revenue $1.42B (+12%); options +31%, event contracts $173M (6x+); net deposits $15.7B.
risks: Crypto revenue -55% y/y; GAAP EPS missed; opex +16%. Prediction markets may draw more scrutiny from a Democratic Congress.
catalyst: Crypto volume recovery; prediction-market growth; October operating data (mid-November).

name: MercadoLibre
thesis: Nov 4 about 1:40pm ET (intraday, not final): $1,754.09 (+5.5%) ahead of Q3 results after the close today (confirmed by the company Oct 29). Consensus about $10.7B revenue (+44%). Q2 net revenue was $10.2B (+50%) while operating income fell 17%; margin trend is the key number.
risks: Brazilian real weakness after Lula's win cuts US-dollar revenue; credit book and logistics absorbing margin.
catalyst: Q3 results Nov 4 after US close; call 5:00pm ET (09:00 AEDT Thu Nov 5).

name: Cloudflare
thesis: Nov 4 about 1:40pm ET (intraday, not final): $264.19 (-3.5%) after +3.2% Nov 3 on JPMorgan's upgrade to Overweight ($350 target). Down about 17% from the Oct 28 close of $318.72 into Q3 results Thursday. Guide was $736-737M revenue; Q2 was $696M (+36%).
risks: 38 moves of more than 5% in a year; needs a clean beat and raise on Thursday.
catalyst: Q3 results Thu Nov 5 after US close, call 5:00pm ET (09:00 AEDT Fri Nov 6).

name: Sea Limited
thesis: Nov 4 about 1:40pm ET (intraday, not final): $81.38 (+6.0%), fourth straight up day and about 10% above the Oct 30 close. No company news found; consumer and e-commerce names led the post-election rally. Q2 revenue $7.79B (+48%).
risks: Sea Cloud spending with no disclosed budget; Shopee competition from TikTok Shop, Temu and Shein; DBS and New Street cuts. Still the weakest name on the list.
catalyst: Q3 results Tue Nov 10 before US open, call 7:30am ET (23:30 AEDT Tue Nov 10); Sea Cloud capex and Monee IPO timing.

name: Keyence
thesis: US OTC line (KYCCF) Nov 4 about 1:40pm ET (intraday, not final): $487.00 (+3.4%) after a 4.9% drop Nov 2. First half (Oct 29): sales JPY 735.4B (+34.9%), operating profit JPY 408.3B (+50%), margin 55.5%. Interim dividend JPY 325; 5-for-1 split effective Nov 21.
risks: Orders now tied to AI and chip capex; BOJ signalled a December hike and a stronger yen cuts reported overseas sales.

name: ASML Holding
thesis: Nov 4 about 1:40pm ET (intraday, not final): $1,498.00 (-3.5%) after +1.7% Nov 3; about 11% below the Oct 28 close. No company news; interim dividend EUR 1.88 paid Nov 4. Q3 sales a record EUR 11.66B; 2026 guide EUR 44-45B and 2027-28 supply short of demand.
risks: Semicap priced for perfection; China about 20% of sales and export rules can change; AI-capex sentiment swings.
catalyst: Applied Materials results Nov 12 (sector read); Q4 results January.

name: Teradyne
thesis: Nov 4 about 1:40pm ET (intraday, not final): $250.00 (-7.2%) after +3.2% Nov 3; about 20% below the Oct 28 close. No company news. Q3 revenue $1,306M (vs $769M a year ago); non-GAAP EPS $2.29; Semi Test $1,072M.
risks: Revenue slightly below Q2; robotics small ($96M); moves with AI accelerator demand sentiment.
catalyst: AI accelerator and HBM test demand; NVDA Nov 17.
